title: King's Indian Defence
blurb: Hand White the centre, then blow it up. The sharpest way to play for a win with Black against 1.d4.

replies.idea: Control e4 and keep every option open — the move order matters less than the setup.
Prepare the fianchetto. The bishop on g7 is the soul of the King's Indian.
There it is. It stares down the long diagonal at White's queenside.
Modest, but it stops e5 and prepares the real break later.
Castle first. You are going to need the king safe before the storm.
